name: Otonari-san ni Goyoujin
source:
Midnight meetings on the balcony...it's our secret time together. Since when did this nightly ritual mean so much to you?

Life in your apartment building is nothing special, until a famous musician suddenly moves in! As you get to know the other tenants better, the love story you were destined to live begins...

[Edited from [url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.voltage.g.otonr.en]Google Play[/url]]
translation:
午夜时分在阳台相会……这是只属于我们的秘密时光。这项每晚进行的仪式，究竟从什么时候开始对你意义非凡？

你在公寓楼里的生活原本平淡无奇，直到一位著名音乐家突然搬了进来！随着你逐渐了解其他住户，一段命中注定的恋爱故事开始了……

[改编自[url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.voltage.g.otonr.en]Google Play[/url]]
